## REVIEW COMMENTS

### Image round-tripping needs an explicit contract

**review comment**: Does making TUI persistence work like FullControlTest include preserving image content and exchanging private documents with the GUI editors? The current representations differ materially. TUI inserts a `DocumentEmbeddedObjectRun` backed by a label retaining `ImageData` in `<GacUI repo>/Test/Resources/App/TuiControlTest/DocumentEditorBase.xml`. FullControlTest's save helper calls `ModifyDocumentForClipboard`, which removes embedded objects in `<GacUI repo>/Source/Resources/GuiDocumentClipboard_Document.cpp`; the RTF/HTML exporters likewise do not persist those controls. GUI private files instead contain `DocumentImageRun`, whose rendering is unsupported by the current TUI provider. Simply attaching the GUI handlers would silently lose inserted TUI images and would not establish correct display of GUI image documents. The task does not specify whether this additional representation work is intended.

**suggested solution**: Preserve image content supported by the existing private format and GUI/TUI interchange while retaining textual image presentation in TUI. Translate between the showcase's TUI display objects and serializable image runs at the document boundary, retaining the image data and dimensions needed for later save/export; reuse the existing private format rather than inventing another format. Verify GUI-to-TUI-to-GUI and TUI-to-GUI round trips with the original image files unavailable, plus image data in RTF/HTML exports. If image persistence is intentionally outside this task, state that limitation explicitly and define the behavior when an image-bearing document is loaded or saved instead of accepting silent data loss.

**user reply**: The screenshot is how CppTest_Tui dealing with image right now. No need to worry about changing the implementation, keep it what it is. Images loaded from memory or binary may not have a path, make sure to render it when the file path is empty like `[Image, 123 x 456]`.

**resolution**: Accepted. Keep the current embedded image-label implementation and presentation, including the existing path-bearing label. Support the specified pathless label for memory/binary images. The document persistence work still retains image data using the existing private format; the earlier suggestion does not require replacing TUI image rendering. The details and verification above now record both label forms, so no image-presentation decision remains open.
